tbesh_html:
Someone descended from Nehel(?), first mentioned at Jer.29.24
§ Nehelamite = "he of the dream"
the designation of a false prophet Shemaiah taken into captivity to Babylon; name is formed from his native place or his progenitor

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam
strongs_1890.derivation: apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of H2492 (חָלַם)); dreamed;
